title: Owners can upload any picture as a shop product photo with no word that they must have the right to use it
what: The product form takes any photo the owner drops in, uploads it at once and shows it to every member in the app shop. Owners often save a supplement brand's picture from a shopping website. Nothing on the form says the photo must be their own or one they may use, so we can end up showing someone else's copyrighted picture in our app with no record that the gym took responsibility.
expected: One short line under the photo box says to use your own photo or one you have permission to use, and the terms say the gym answers for pictures it uploads.
fix_line: Add a one-line rights reminder under the photo box

items.reason: web admin panel only; no iPhone app code or App Store listing lives in this area
